headline: Say it across the yard
lede: Homebody's court had a rule for crowded rings but none for empty lawns: the word only reached whoever already stood within arm's reach. Now a tap on Fern, Ivy or Pip across the lot sends your resident walking, and the compliment lands the tick they meet — the old Sims idiom, own IP. Alongside it, the picker's own ledger got honest: two buried gap records unearthed and one stale hash pin re-sampled.

notes.text: Go-say ships (#2683, merged a35a9aa): far-person tap walks the word over; arrival promotes to the #2235 pick, waits on cooldown, folds honest when the ear leaves, faints or sleeps, and chases a slipping target exactly three re-paths. Queue parity rides the #2470 list; the promise speaks as its own resident even after you switch hands.

peoplecheck 876/876 (+26, two hand-mutants proven named), homebodydrive 108/108 including a real-pointer far-tap with the travelling gold ring captured on canvas (33 px). 99/99 queue, 14/14 contract, lint + build green.

Honest-gap accounting: the picker had been re-kicking shipped work because a CLOSED-by-#2672 strike sat on unindented README lines parseGaps can't see; fixed, ring tail struck, and the long-buried deeper-multi-room tail surfaced as its own honest bullet. homebodyqueuecheck's autoplay hash pin, aged across four hash joins since #2508, re-sampled with proof the autopilot is byte-identical.
